question: For how much is Datavault AI acquiring CyberCatch?

hits.title: NetworkNewsBreaks - Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT) enters LOI to acquire CyberCatch.
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-05-01 | CAD $136.8 million] Datavault Inc. acquired CyberCatch, Inc. for $100M on May 1st '26. Datavault AI (NASDAQ: DVLT), a provider of data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement and real-world asset ("RWA") tokenization technologies, and CyberCatch (TSXV: CYBE) (OTCQB: CYBHF), a cybersecurity company offering a patented, AI-enabled platform for continuous compliance and cyber risk mitigation, announced they have entered into a binding letter of intent under which Datavault AI will acquire 100% of CyberCatch in an all-stock transaction valued at about CAD $136.8 million.
hits.summary: Datavault Inc. acquired CyberCatch, Inc. for $100M on May 1st '26.

extract.answer: About CAD $136.8 million in an all-stock transaction.

accuracy.note: Answer gives CAD $136.8 million, not the gold figure of $94.5 million; the stated amount does not match the gold cell as written.
